figures.finding: The FSM's national corporations law as introduced in Congress (C.B. 20-34, the Business Organization Act of 2016) sets no age: one or more individuals may incorporate by filing articles with the Registrar, and the articles or bylaws may prescribe directors' qualifications, a director needing to be neither a citizen, a resident nor a shareholder unless they say so. A minor's capacity to sign is then the general law's, which is a blocker (majority).
figures.applies: The bill's text from the FSM Congress (introduced 24 May 2017); its enactment as P.L. 20-35 rests on the search tool's reading of fsmlaw.org, whose copy answered 406 to this client, so the enacted wording is unconfirmed.
figures.webSearch: 2026-11-01: 'Micronesia FSM corporation law incorporator director minimum age Title 36 Registrar of Corporations requirements' returned fsmlaw.org's Title 36 pages and P.L. 20-35 (406 Mod Security to this client), PacLII's 2014 consolidation (403 per layer 3), the Congress bills (C.B. 20-34 used), Expanship (directors adults, 18; no statute).

sources.said: Section 116. Incorporators. One or more … individuals may act as the incorporator or … incorporators of a corporation by delivering … articles of incorporation to the Registrar for … filing. … Section 178. Qualifications of directors. The … articles of incorporation or bylaws may prescribe … qualifications for directors. A director need not … be a citizen or resident of the Federated States … of Micronesia or a shareholder of the corporation … unless the articles of incorporation or bylaws so … prescribe.
